description: This file defines the ProductPrice class used in an e-commerce application to encapsulate product pricing details, including descriptions, availability, special pricing, and related product information.

classes.name: ProductPrice
classes.description: A Java class representing product pricing details, including price, descriptions, availability, special pricing, and associated product information.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of price descriptions for the product.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of price descriptions for the product.

methods.name: getPriceText
methods.description: Returns the textual representation of the price.

methods.name: setPriceText
methods.description: Sets the textual representation of the price.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the core ProductPrice object containing detailed pricing info.

methods.name: getSpecialPriceText
methods.description: Returns the textual representation of any special price.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the product associated with this price.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with this pricing information.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date for the special price as a string.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the special price.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date for the special price as a string.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the special price.
